page_title: BEL 3-2 SEN | Belgium v Senegal 01/07/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 120+12' It's all over as the match has ended.
120+12' Pape Matar Sarr (Senegal) produces a poor free kick which sails wide.
120+11' The players claim that Nicolas Raskin (Belgium) handled the ball and it seems they are right. Senegal have a free kick from a promising distance.
120+11' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
120+11' Pathe Ciss (Senegal) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
120+9' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Senegal, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
120+7' Pape Matar Sarr (Senegal) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
120+5' 3 - 2 Goal! Youri Tielemans (Belgium) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Mory Diaw into the top right corner.
120+5' Youri Tielemans (Belgium) is going to take the penalty!
120+1' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Belgium!
120' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

118' Play continues despite the shouts by some Belgium players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Said Martinez interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
117' Dodi Lukebakio (Belgium) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only crashes against the crossbar.
117' One of the Belgium players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
115' A corner kick by Senegal is thwarted by the well prepared Thibaut Courtois (Belgium).
114' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Nicolas Raskin (Belgium), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles away of the left post. Poor effort.
114' Nicolas Jackson (Senegal) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Senegal will have a chance to score from a corner.
113' Bara Sapoko Ndiaye (Senegal) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Thibaut Courtois easily deals with the threat.
112' Pape Matar Sarr (Senegal) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
111' Diego Moreira (Belgium) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
109' Leandro Trossard goes off the pitch and Amadou Onana (Belgium) comes on.
109' A big opportunity missed by Ibrahim Mbaye (Senegal). He got on the ball inside the box and thumped a splendid first-time shot on goal, but it went narrowly wide of the left post.
108' Ibrahim Mbaye (Senegal) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
107' The game is interrupted now, Diego Moreira (Belgium) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
106' Said Martinez has blown his whistle to start the second period of extra time.
105+1' The first period of extra-time has ended, but the drama in this match is not yet finished.
105' Nicolas Raskin (Belgium) runs into space on the edge of the box and tries a curler that drifts well wide of the left post.
104' Leandro Trossard (Belgium) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
101' Thomas Meunier (Belgium) was too forceful with his tackle and Said Martinez interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
99' Diego Moreira (Belgium) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
97' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Thomas Meunier (Belgium).
96' That's the end of the game for Idrissa Gueye, who is replaced by Bara Sapoko Ndiaye (Senegal).
94' That will be all from Sadio Mane who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Nicolas Jackson (Senegal).
94' Pape Bouna Thiaw has decided to make a change. El Hadji Malick Diouf (Senegal) replaces Ismail Jakobs.
93' Said Martinez blows his whistle and it's Timothy Castagne (Belgium) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
91' The first period of extra-time has just started.
90+8' The referee has ended the second half.
90+6' Idrissa Gueye (Senegal) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
90+5' The attendance is 66925.
90+4' Diego Moreira (Belgium) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
90+2' The resulting set piece from Belgium is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Referee Said Martinez halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Rudi Garcia, then shows him a yellow.

89' 2 - 2 It's a goal! Youri Tielemans (Belgium) makes it 2:2. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Leandro Trossard and planted his close-range header into the left side of the goal. Mory Diaw was helpless.
88' Ibrahim Mbaye (Senegal) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the right-hand post.

86' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Romelu Lukaku (Belgium) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the roof of the net. The assist goes to Thomas Meunier and the score changes to 1:2.
85' Sadio Mane (Senegal) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
84' Youri Tielemans (Belgium) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post.
83' Timothy Castagne (Belgium) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the right post! What a huge opportunity!
82' Ismail Jakobs (Senegal) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
80' Timothy Castagne (Belgium) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Said Martinez blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Senegal will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
79' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Sadio Mane (Senegal).
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Maxim De Cuyper departs the field of play to be replaced by Thomas Meunier (Belgium).
78' Dodi Lukebakio (Belgium) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
77' Arthur Theate (Belgium) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
73' Pape Bouna Thiaw prepares a substitution. Habib Diarra is replaced by Pape Matar Sarr (Senegal).
73' Substitution. Iliman Ndiaye is replaced by Ibrahim Mbaye (Senegal).
70' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
70' Maxim De Cuyper (Belgium) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
67' Said Martinez shows a yellow card to Lamine Camara (Senegal), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
66' Here is a change. Pape Gueye is going off and Pape Bouna Thiaw gives the last tactical orders to Lamine Camara (Senegal).
65' Romelu Lukaku (Belgium) is adjudged offside.
64' Said Martinez shows the yellow card to Brandon Mechele (Belgium) for a heavy challenge.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hans Vanaken trots off the pitch and is replaced by Diego Moreira (Belgium).
62' Dodi Lukebakio (Belgium) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
61' Belgium failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
60' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Youri Tielemans (Belgium) inside the box. Belgium have been awarded a corner kick.
60' Dodi Lukebakio (Belgium) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
57' Brandon Mechele (Belgium) is inside the box in a promising position to head home! His poor header flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was!
56' Rudi Garcia has decided to substitute Jeremy Doku and he is replaced by Dodi Lukebakio (Belgium).
56' Substitution. Kevin De Bruyne makes way for Nicolas Raskin (Belgium).
56' Jeremy Doku (Belgium) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
53' Said Martinez blows for a foul after Youri Tielemans (Belgium) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

51' 0 - 2 Moussa Niakhate sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot inside the right post. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 0:2.
51' Habib Diarra (Senegal) unleashes a powerful first-time volley towards goal, but the ball goes well wide of the left post.
50' Maxim De Cuyper (Belgium) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Iliman Ndiaye (Senegal) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the left post.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Rudi Garcia probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Charles De Ketelaere. He is replaced by Romelu Lukaku (Belgium).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+6' Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) tries his luck with a shot, but his effort goes wide of the target.
45+5' Maxim De Cuyper (Belgium) unleashes a powerful shot from the free kick but it only hits the defensive wall.
45+4' Said Martinez blows his whistle and signals a foul after Sadio Mane (Senegal) brought his opponent down. Belgium win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
45+3' Pape Gueye (Senegal) tackles a bit over-zealously and Said Martinez blows for a foul.
45+1' Pape Gueye (Senegal) smashes the ball with a volley from the edge of the box, but his poor attempt goes miles wide of the left post.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Senegal.
45' The referee points to the corner flag and Belgium will take a corner.

45' Maxim De Cuyper (Belgium) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Mory Diaw thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
45' Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) works the corner short.
44' Charles De Ketelaere (Belgium) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Belgium are awarded a corner kick.
44' Pape Gueye (Senegal) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Said Martinez blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Jeremy Doku (Belgium) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
41' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Maxim De Cuyper (Belgium) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
41' A pass into the penalty area from Maxim De Cuyper (Belgium) is intercepted by the defence.
38' Leandro Trossard (Belgium) commits a foul and Said Martinez immediately signals a free kick.
38' Jeremy Doku (Belgium) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
37' Sadio Mane (Senegal) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
35' Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
31' A fan invades the pitch and the game has to be interrupted!
27' A cooling break is underway.
25' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the right post.
24' 0 - 1 Goal! Habib Diarra (Senegal) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 0:1.
23' Sadio Mane (Senegal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
21' Youri Tielemans (Belgium) is penalised for holding. Said Martinez signals a set piece.
20' Sadio Mane (Senegal) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
19' The resulting corner, taken by Krepin Diatta (Senegal), comes to nothing.
19' Krepin Diatta (Senegal) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Senegal.
17' Idrissa Gueye (Senegal) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Thibaut Courtois makes a comfortable save.
13' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the right post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
13' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) sends a rebound from close range to the right post.
13' Ismail Jakobs (Senegal) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Thibaut Courtois intercepts the ball.
12' Ismail Jakobs (Senegal) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
10' Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.

9' Leandro Trossard (Belgium) was in a good shooting position just outside the box and unleashed a first-time shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper made a decent save to thwart his effort.
9' Charles De Ketelaere (Belgium) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
7' Youri Tielemans (Belgium) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Said Martinez signals.
6' Leandro Trossard (Belgium) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
3' The ball is cleared after Jeremy Doku (Belgium) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
2' A cross from Sadio Mane (Senegal) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
